posts.content:
We’re Hiring in Dubai | Business Analyst – FMCG

Meethaq Manpower is seeking a Business Analyst for a multinational FMCG company in the confectionery and sweet snacks sector. Based on-site in Dubai, the role supports sales and commercial strategy across the Lower Gulf by analysing performance across brands and customer channels.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of FMCG commercial experience, with skills in sales reporting, budget and target tracking, and profitability analysis. The role requires proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, along with knowledge of SAP and Power BI.

A university degree and fluency in English are required. Candidates should be available to start immediately.

How to apply
Send your CV to careers@meethaq.ae and use Business Analyst – FMCG as the subject line.
For the full job description and to apply online, visit: https://lnkd.in/dBSbkxUs
